verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Runbooks are its automation engine, but the evidence shows they are triggered by events: they evaluate conditions whenever an incident is declared. Nothing documents time-based or recurring execution of jobs or workflows. On-call Schedules and Rotations recur, but they define shift assignments, which is an adjacent feature and not scheduled automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
